# ScreenshotOne

> ScreenshotOne is a hosted website rendering API for screenshots, PDFs, videos, and rendered page content.

## Product and company

- [Information for AI](https://screenshotone.com/ai-information/): Capabilities, pricing, limitations, company facts, customer evidence, and official resources.
- [Pricing](https://screenshotone.com/pricing/): Current plans, allowances, and billing policies.
- [About](https://screenshotone.com/about/): The founder story.

## Documentation

- [Getting started](https://screenshotone.com/docs/getting-started/): Set up the API and make your first request.
- [Documentation index](https://screenshotone.com/docs/llms.txt): Links to all documentation pages.
- [Full documentation](https://screenshotone.com/docs/llms-full.txt): API documentation as text.
- [MCP setup and tools](https://screenshotone.com/docs/mcp/): Connect compatible AI clients and use the hosted MCP server.
